import math

def main():
    x, y, n = map(float, input().split())
    n = int(n)
    
    bestError = 1e18
    bestNum = 0
    bestDen = 1
    
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        targetRatio = x / y
        rawVal = targetRatio * i
        
        tryNums = [math.floor(rawVal), math.ceil(rawVal)]
        
        for num in tryNums:
            currentError = abs(targetRatio - num / i)
            if currentError < bestError:
                bestError = currentError
                bestNum = num
                bestDen = i
    
    print(f"{bestNum}/{bestDen}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
